content.test_md_blob:
# Leave the performance chart to dismiss hover details

> Prove pointer exit hides the tooltip after a hover interaction has displayed it.

## Step 1

Open {{portfolio_overview_url}} in a browser and wait for the Portfolio Overview workspace to finish loading with the Portfolio Performance card visible.

## Step 2

On the Portfolio Overview page, store the current dashboard summary card values as baseline_summary_cards.

## Step 3

Hover a visible data point on the Portfolio Performance chart and confirm the custom tooltip is visible.

## Step 4

Store the visible hover tooltip state as baseline_visible_tooltip.

## Step 5

Move the pointer out of the chart plotting area.

## Step 6

Confirm the tooltip is no longer visible and the dashboard summary cards still match baseline_summary_cards.

## Step 7 — assert @verifies ac-14, ac-24, ac-39

Confirm 'tooltip after pointer leaves the chart' does NOT appear (forbidden-presence) — the stated promise: Pointer leaving the chart hides the tooltip.
